svg.title: Conics and the focus–directrix condition
svg.desc: Three Cartesian panels with equal horizontal and vertical units. The ellipse x²/9+y²/4=1 has focus (√5,0), directrix x=9/√5, and eccentricity √5/3. The parabola y²=4x has focus (1,0), directrix x=-1, and eccentricity 1. The hyperbola x²/4-y²=1 has focus (√5,0), directrix x=4/√5, and eccentricity √5/2. Purple segments show PF and amber segments show perpendicular distance PH to the directrix; PF=e PH.
